# Vendored libraries

Loaded on demand by `pages/report-pdf.js` (Save PDF on the Reports page).
Bundled here instead of a CDN so the app has no runtime third-party script dependency.

| File | Package | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jspdf-4.2.1.umd.min.js` | jspdf 4.2.1 | https://registry.npmjs.org/jspdf/-/jspdf-4.2.1.tgz (`dist/jspdf.umd.min.js`) | MIT (`LICENSE-jspdf.txt`) |
| `jspdf-autotable-5.0.8.min.js` | jspdf-autotable 5.0.8 | https://registry.npmjs.org/jspdf-autotable/-/jspdf-autotable-5.0.8.tgz (`dist/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js`) | MIT (`LICENSE-jspdf-autotable.txt`) |
